data.title: Welcome to {{projectName}}
data.summary: The page the starter renders first — proof that the front end, the CDA token and the site are wired to each other.
data.content:
This page was created by the nextjs-starter blueprint. It exists so the project has something to render before you have written anything: open /welcome in the dev server and you are looking at content that came out of the CMS.

The catch-all route at app/[...slug]/page.tsx resolves a post by its friendly URL, so this page's identity is /welcome — renaming it is a move, not a re-creation.

Edit it, or delete it and publish your own.

data.title: About
data.summary: A second page, so the home listing has more than one row and the catch-all route is exercised by more than one URL.
data.content:
Two pages is the smallest number that shows the starter's home page doing its job: it lists every published post, and each row links to the catch-all route.

Add fields to the Page post-type in the console (or in shio/post-types/Page.json and shio push), and read them from post.attrs in the route.
